This requires a feedback loop that transforms 'one-off' problem-solving into 'evergreen' content. The universal lens identifies this as a closed-loop system: user queries enter the support queue, resolved tickets become inputs to an update policy, and approved changes populate the FAQ database. The key failure mode is information silos—resolved tickets forgotten and unanswered future queries. To prevent this, we enforce a strict separation of concerns: production systems remain untouched, and all changes undergo manual review before deployment. The telemetry metrics focus on reducing redundancy rather than optimizing individual performance.
